title: Watch appetite grow before it rules you
summary: The shabad gives appetite a biography, beginning with innocent dependence and warning how desire keeps taking new names. Watch the want before it learns to speak as you.
takeaway: Do not let a passing want learn your name.
lifeApplication: When a desire repeats itself, do not only ask whether it is allowed. Ask what identity it is training in you, and bring that training back under the Guru's gaze.

source.shortMeaning: Appetite grows through stages until it can feel like the self unless the Guru interrupts it.
source.lifeApplication: Notice the repeated want early enough to keep it from becoming identity.

evidence.coreClaim: Appetite grows through stages until it can feel like the self unless the Guru interrupts it.
evidence.turn: The shabad turns craving from a private urge into a lifelong pattern that can be seen, named, and submitted to the Guru.
evidence.practicalImplication: When a desire repeats itself, do not only ask whether it is allowed. Ask what identity it is training in you, and bring that training back under the Guru's gaze.
